children: Abercrombie & Fitch Co. reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $1.27B and diluted EPS of $4.17, driven by AUR gains and expanded store and third‑party channel coverage; net income was $183.72M, up year over year.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to A&F”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per share attributable to A&F”.
Revenue growth was driven by higher average unit retail (AUR) despite flat comparable store sales; net sales rose 5% in the quarter and 3% year‑to‑date.
Channel and store expansion supported growth, with 24 net new store openings year‑to‑date and gains from third‑party channel expansion.
Brand performance: Abercrombie led with an 8% sales increase and positive comps; Hollister produced steady, modest growth.

Operational actions included recognition of approximately $100M in IEEPA tariff refunds that improved cost of goods sold, investment in about 40 store remodels, and continued digital and omnichannel enhancements.
Management is executing sourcing, pricing and expense initiatives to address tariff, freight and global supply challenges.
